name: Endosome, phagosome and autophagosome fusion with lysosomes
rationale: All members concern delivery of endocytic, phagocytic or autophagic compartments into lysosomes by fusion (SARS-CoV-2 targets autophagosome-lysosome fusion), unlike confusables about autophagosome assembly, selective autophagy or Golgi-to-lysosome biogenesis.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling and endocytic downregulation
name: MET and PTK6 signalling with RTK endocytic downregulation
rationale: Members cover HGF/MET receptor signalling, PTK6 (BRK) signalling and ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis/MVB sorting that downregulates EGFR/ERBB/MET, whereas confusables are dominated by ERBB adaptor events and PI3K/ALK signalling without MET, PTK6 or receptor degradation.

name: Insulin receptor signalling via IRS-AKT2 and its attenuation
rationale: All members concern insulin receptor signalling through IRS and AKT2 to glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis and its negative regulation, distinguishing it from adiponectin, glucagon and generic PI3K/IGF1R confusables.

name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketogenesis
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA beta-oxidation steps, carnitine synthesis/transport and ketone body synthesis and use (GLUT1 deficiency relates to ketogenic fuel), unlike confusables on branched-chain amino acid/pyruvate catabolism or fatty acid transport.

name: Atypical polyubiquitin chains and ISGylation in interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members combine non-K48/K63 ubiquitin chain formation (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free chains) with ISG15 conjugation and interferon-alpha antiviral restriction, unlike confusables centred on deubiquitinases, protein quality control or viral replication.

name: Lipid second-messenger and PKC signalling from G beta-gamma and BCR
rationale: Members share PLC/PI3K-generated lipid second messengers, calcium and PKC signalling downstream of G beta-gamma, lysophospholipid receptors, VEGFR2 and the B cell receptor, unlike confusables limited to BCR regulation, Fc-gamma phagocytosis or GPCR calcium signalling.

name: Ubiquitin editing and deubiquitinase control of TNFR1-NF-kappaB signalling
rationale: Members combine TNFR1/NF-kappaB signalling regulation with deubiquitinase families, K48/K63/K11/linear chain editing and immune-protein SUMOylation, distinguishing it from confusables about IKK/TAK1 activation by TLR, NOD and TNFSF receptors.

name: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 gp130 cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are IL-6, IL-27 or IL-35 signalling (gp130-using cytokines) including IL-6-driven ERK1/2 activation, distinguished from confusables with other IL-6-family (CNTF, LIF, IL-11) or common-gamma-chain cytokines by IL-27/IL-35.

name: Meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasma formation and chromosome segregation
rationale: Members are structural events of meiotic chromosome cohesion, chiasma assembly, alignment and segregation, unlike confusables on meiotic checkpoints and phase transitions or mitotic cohesion.

name: TCA cycle intermediates, pyruvate and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members concern TCA cycle dicarboxylates (malate, oxaloacetate, 2-oxoglutarate), pyruvate supply and the malate-aspartate shuttle, unlike confusables on electron transport, PDH/CoA, glutamate/alanine metabolism or dicarboxylate transporters.

core: Cellular response to oxidative and nitrosative stress
name: Hydrogen peroxide and nitrosative stress responses with oxidative apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydroperoxides and reactive nitrogen species including BACH1/HMOX1 regulation and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis, distinguished from confusables on ROS detoxification, ferroptosis and hypoxia.

core: Chemokine and dendritic cell cytokine production
name: cGAS-STING-driven CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production
rationale: Members concern cGAS/STING activation (including cGAMP import) and the resulting CCL5 and dendritic-cell cytokine production, unlike confusables on type I/III interferon induction or macrophage CXCL/MCP-1 chemokines.

core: Water and solute transport across epithelial barriers
name: Water, magnesium and inositol transport across epithelial barriers
rationale: Members cover aquaporin water transport, claudin-based paracellular and magnesium transport, inositol transporters and blood-brain-barrier lipid transport, distinguished from confusables on tight junctions and cation-chloride cotransport by aquaporin water handling.

name: Apical membrane phospholipid translocation and canalicular bile secretion
rationale: Members concern apical/raft membrane transport including phospholipid flipping, ABCB4/ABCB11 bile canalicular transport and CFTR, distinguished from confusables on CFTR trafficking and transepithelial water by lipid translocation and bile secretion.

name: NOXA and PUMA BH3-only inactivation of anti-apoptotic BCL-2
rationale: Members describe NOXA and PUMA activation and their neutralisation of anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins leading to cytochrome c release, unlike confusables on BAX/BAK, other BH3-only proteins or p53 transcription.

name: Lysophospholipid and phosphoinositide lipid signalling
rationale: The three members share only a loose lipid-signalling theme (S1P/LPA receptors, PLC-PKC-driven VEGFR2 proliferation, phosphatidylinositol synthesis regulation), which is unrelated to the vitamin K, eicosanoid, coagulation and endocannabinoid confusables.

name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescence-associated heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members regulate entry into cellular senescence, especially oncogene-induced senescence with SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and proliferation arrest, distinguished from confusables on SASP, replicative/oxidative senescence and p53 apoptosis.

name: Methionine biosynthesis via methionine synthase and its reductase
rationale: All members concern methionine synthesis by MTR/MTRR-dependent homocysteine remethylation, unlike confusables on SAM/choline, folate or cobalamin metabolism.

name: CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the GTPase cycles and signalling of CDC42 and the related RHOJ and RHOG, distinguishing them from RAC, RHOA/B/C and RHOD/U/V confusables.

name: EGFR and ERBB2 phosphotyrosine adaptor and PLC-gamma signalling
rationale: Members are adaptor/effector recruitment events (GRB2, SHC1, GRB7, GAB1, PI3K, PLC-gamma1) downstream of EGFR and ERBB2, unlike confusables centred on ERBB3/ERBB4 signalling or EGFR transactivation.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of mutant FLT3
rationale: All members describe FLT3 mutants binding or resisting specific TKIs, distinguished from ALK, KIT and PDGFR TKI-resistance and FLT3 signalling confusables.

name: ER tubule shaping, membrane fusion and contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER tethering and phospholipid/cholesterol transfer, unlike confusables on ER-mitochondria tethering and phosphoinositide synthesis.

name: Extracellular matrix and integrin cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members are ECM gene modules, integrin surface interactions, fibronectin matrix and collagen-receptor adhesion, distinguished from confusables on collagen fibril assembly/degradation, EMT and stromal fibroblasts by integrin adhesion.

name: APC/C activity control at mitotic exit via Emi1 degradation
rationale: Members concern regulation of APC/C ubiquitin ligase activity across metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit, including Emi1 phosphorylation and SCF-beta-TrCP degradation and Cdc6 removal, which the APC/C substrate-degradation confusables lack.

name: DNA mismatch repair and its hereditary defects
rationale: All members are MutS/MutL-directed mismatch repair or its MLH1/MSH2/MSH3/MSH6 defects, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair and recombination.
